subject: CobaltMetrics onboarding: missing insurance details + PO billing code
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cobaltmetrics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cobaltmetrics.com
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet and PO details

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the checklist. I attached our standard COI and W9 for your review (files attached). A couple quick questions while we finish the SOW: 

- For the COI, who should be listed as the certificate holder and is there an additional insured endorsement required?
- What PO number do you need so our billing team can map invoices correctly?
- Do you require a separate subcontractor disclosure form? We will need to confirm which of our delivery partners are subvendors.

I attached COI_CobaltMetrics_2027-11-12.pdf and Cobalt_W9_2027.pdf. Let me know if the COI limits need updating.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Operations Lead, CobaltMetrics LLC
sofia.ramos@cobaltmetrics.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cobaltmetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet and PO details

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for sending the COI and W9. Quick notes after a first pass:

1) Certificate holder: please list "Redwood Inference, Inc., 2121 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110" as the certificate holder exactly (no abbreviations).
2) Additional insured: we require an Additional Insured endorsement on General Liability for direct work on our environment (it can be a blanket endorsement CG 20 10 or equivalent).
3) Cyber Liability: minimum $2M per occurrence; please confirm your carrier and policy number on the COI.
4) Subcontractors: we ask for a one-page subcontractor disclosure listing company names and country of incorporation for any subcontractor that will process Redwood data. If none, reply "None".

For PO routing: our Procurement team issues a PO once the SOW is countersigned. Can you confirm the billing contact and whether invoices will be sent to finance@cobaltmetrics.com or AP@cobaltmetrics.com? If you provide the preferred invoice email and tax ID we can provision the vendor record and provide a PO number (usually 7 days after vendor setup).

Looping Marissa and Markus to confirm the timing and whether we need an endorsement template.

Thanks,
Rachel
Procurement Lead 
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cobaltmetrics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 08:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet and PO details

Hi all —

Quick follow-up from vendor setup side:

- Rachel: to expedite the PO, I need the remit-to billing address, preferred invoice email, and the vendor tax ID (EIN). Please send those in reply.
- Sofia: the COI as submitted lists 1M GL only; we will need the carrier to issue an endorsement raising GL to 2M and naming Redwood Inference, Inc. as additional insured. If your broker prefers, we can accept an endorsement PDF and amended COI.
- Markus: please confirm whether the cyber limit note Rachel added should be a hard block (vendor cannot be activated without 2M) or a risk exception path.

Sofia — if you expect a lead time with your broker, we can do vendor provisioning with PO pending (conditional PO). That will let your billing team invoice against a temporary hold while endorsements clear.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cobaltmetrics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cobaltmetrics.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:57:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet and PO details

Hi Marissa / Rachel —

Thanks. We can get an endorsement issued but it may take 3 business days from our broker. Billing contact is AP@cobaltmetrics.com (remit-to: CobaltMetrics LLC, 310 Pine St, Oakland, CA 94607). EIN: 12-3456789. We will also prepare the one-page subcontractor disclosure — currently we have two subvendors (NovaData, UK Ltd; MetricOps, India Pvt Ltd) that may be listed for work that touches telemetry ingestion.

We accept the conditional PO approach — please issue the PO number when vendor provisioning is complete and note it as conditional until the endorsement posts. We'll timestamp invoices with the PO number and include the amended COI when available.

I'll upload the endorsement as soon as it ships from the broker.

Best,
Sofia
S. Ramos
Operations Lead, CobaltMetrics
